name: Mcp4461 → Wiper Set Terminal
description: Connects or disconnects a single resistor-network terminal of the given channel at runtime. `terminal` is one of `a`, `b`, `w` or `h` (hardware shutdown state).

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the MCP4461 output channel.

config_entries.label: Enable
config_entries.description: Whether to connect (`true`) or disconnect (`false`) the terminal.
